name: Standard Meeting Notes
description: A standard template for general meetings, focusing on key outcomes and actions.

sections.title: Summary
sections.instruction: Provide a brief, one-paragraph executive summary of the entire meeting.

sections.title: Key Decisions
sections.instruction: List only explicit decisions. Include a short verbatim quote from the transcript as evidence. Omit uncertain decisions.

sections.title: Action Items
sections.instruction: List only explicit commitments with owner and due date when stated. Include a short verbatim quote from the transcript as evidence. Do not infer an owner or deadline.

sections.title: Open Questions
sections.instruction: List explicit questions or issues that remained unresolved. Include a short verbatim quote from the transcript as evidence.

sections.title: Discussion Highlights
sections.instruction: Summarize the main topics of discussion, key arguments, and important insights.
